description:
Etonia is a handwriting notebook for iPad and iPhone where every note-taking feature is 100% free with zero ads—paired with an AI tutor that annotates directly on your page and guides you step by step through your notes.

ALL NOTE-TAKING FEATURES FREE — NO ADS
Every essential notebook tool is completely free, forever, with no ads, no page limits, and no watermarks:
• Smooth, low-latency Apple Pencil ink: ballpoint, fountain pen, pencil, and highlighter
• Hold at the end of a stroke to snap crisp geometric shapes and lines
• Erase by stroke or by area, and lasso to move, scale, rotate, copy, or restyle your writing
• Unlimited notebooks and nested folders with fast handwriting search
• Blank, lined, grid, or dotted paper in A4, Letter, square, or infinite canvas
• Movable sticky notes, images, typed text boxes, and multi-page chapter overview
• Import and annotate PDFs, import Goodnotes backups from Google Drive, and export as PDF, PNG, or vector SVG
• Record audio synced to your handwriting strokes with on-device transcription

AI THAT ANNOTATES ON YOUR NOTES
Circle or select any handwritten question, formula, or diagram and ask Etonia. Instead of replying only in a detached chat box, Etonia writes step-by-step math, explanations, and diagrams straight onto your page in neat handwriting—or calibrated to your own handwriting—and plots coordinate axes, curves, roots, and extrema right beside your work.

GUIDED STEP-BY-STEP WALKTHROUGHS
Every paragraph in the AI explanation is linked to the exact strokes and plotted points on your note. As you scroll or tap through the assistant's explanation, Etonia highlights the matching equation, handwritten step, and graph feature on your page in real time—guiding you through complex problems step by step.

CHOOSE YOUR AI MODEL
Pick from models by Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google, from fast everyday answers to deep mathematical reasoning.

YOUR NOTES STAY YOURS
Notes are stored locally on your device, with optional backup to your own Google Drive. When you ask the AI, only the part of the page you selected is sent.

OPTIONAL AI PLANS
All note-taking features in Etonia are free with no ads. Optional Starter, Pro, and Max subscriptions add AI: Haiku and Luna are unlimited on every paid plan, and each plan includes a monthly or yearly token allowance for larger models. Subscriptions are billed through your Apple ID and renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
